items.title: Mahomet Cub Scout Pack 25
items.text:
Cub Scout Pack 25 in Mahomet, Illinois was formed on November 30, 1947* and is chartered by the Mahomet-Seymour Parent Teacher Organization. We are a member of the Prairielands Council within Scouting America.

We welcome ALL youth in grades K-5 and meet regularly for fun, adventure, and learning — building character, citizenship, and confidence in youth.

items.title: Fall 2026 Registration
items.text: See our General Info Flyer and join us for our "New Parent Info & Registration Night" on August 17, 2026 at 6:30 PM at the Lincoln Trail Elementary School Cafeteria. Come meet our leaders, ask questions, and see why Cub Scouts is the perfect fit for your child. Children do not need to attend, but are welcome to. If you are not able to attend, message us on Facebook or reach out via email below.

items.title: Pack 25 Swim Adventure
items.text:
When: Monday, August 24th — Check-in at 6:00 PM, tests start at 6:30 PM

Where: Sholem Aquatic Center

RSVP: Sign up on this sheet

Rain Date

Our rain date is August 31st. We'll send a pack-wide email no later than 5 PM on Monday, August 24th if we need to reschedule.

items.title: What to Bring
items.text:
• Completed Annual Health and Medical Form — you'll turn this in to get your buddy tag.
  • Towel and other swimming accessories (optional)
  • Dry clothes in case you get chilly

items.title: What to Expect
items.text: This experience enables our Cub Scouts to earn the elective swimming adventure for their rank. We will swim in areas designated by swimming ability and always with our buddy. A hallmark of the summer camp pool experience is the BUDDY CHECK — everyone gets out of the water and sits on the edge of the pool while staff confirms our safety by reviewing pairs and making sure they're swimming in the appropriate area.

items.title: Station 1: Swim Classification & Entry/Exit
items.text:
Administer swim tests and practice safe water entry/exit strategies.

Classification Requirement / Test Standard Target Ranks Non-Swimmer Did not attempt or complete test. Activity restricted to shallow water (waist-deep or less). Lions & Tigers (water entry/comfort) Beginner Jump feet-first into deep water, swim 25 feet, turn, and return to start. Wolves & Bears Swimmer Jump feet-first into deep water; swim 75 yards using strong strokes, plus 25 yards using a restful backstroke (100 yards total); rest on back to show floating ability. Bears, Webelos, AOL

items.title: Station 2: Relay & Skill Instruction
items.text:
• Lions & Tigers: Kickboard skills and blowing bubbles.
  • Wolves: Basic swimming stroke development and jumping feet-first into chest-deep water.
  • Bears, Webelos & AOL: Treading water, self-rescue, and reach/throw rescues.

items.title: Station 3: Free Swim & Buddy System
items.text: Use the Buddy System with regular Buddy Checks called by leaders for 30 minutes.

items.title: Siblings & Parents
items.text: Cub Scouting is for families! To participate, please bring a completed medical form. The staff at Sholem will designate a separate area for your free swim unless you are serving as the buddy for your Cub Scout.

items.title: Medical Forms
items.text: Per Scouting America, anyone participating must turn in a medical form. A pro tip is to fill this out as a PDF so you can make minor updates each year. Download the Medical Form.
